messages.subject: Pairwise comparison problem
messages.subject_clean: Pairwise comparison problem
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am using K-sample test and when trying to use pairwise and I got the
following error:

> cucos <- read.table("/Users/Manuel/Documents/Proyectos_en_R/Datos/cucos.txt",header=T,sep="",quote="")
> k.sample.test(formula=d(largo) ~ especie,
+ data=cucos,
+ test=oneway.test,var.equal=TRUE)
                           One-way analysis of
means
             F (num df,denom df)      p-value
largo 10.44934           (5,114) 2.852143e-08
> pairwise.t.test(cucos$largo,cucos$especiepool.sd <http://especiepool.sd> = TRUE, p.adjust.method = 'none')
Error: inesperado '=' en "pairwise.t.test(cucos$largo,cucos
$especiepool.sd <http://especiepool.sd> ="
>

I think there is an error in the arguments (there is no comma
separating "especie" form "pool.sd <http://pool.sd>").

Thank you very much in advance.

Manuel

messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,

I have been using JGR/Deducer with much success on my old 32 bit Mac
running on 10.6.x
However I have not been able to load Deducer since I moved to my new
computer running Lion.

I installed all packages from CRAN. Version of deducer is 0.4-4,
version of R is 2.14.

Error message I get:

Error in assign(".jgr.works", TRUE,
as.environment(match("package:JGR",  :
  cannot change value of locked binding for '.jgr.works'
Failed with error:  'package 'Deducer' could not be loaded'

The data viewer and the menu items work. The dialog boxes work. I can
load data but when I click "run" on the dialog box, further error
shows up.

I am really desperate to get this to work as I have a deadline to meet
and I cannot run Deducer :( and I am too stupid to use R on the
terminal.

Please help me!

messages.subject_clean: Problem loading deducer on Mac 10.7.2 / Macbook air
messages.body_plain:
Hi Henry,

0.4-4 is incompatible with R 2.14. A new version has been released to
CRAN, but the mac binaries have not yet been built. In the mean time
you should be able to install it by entering the following:

update.packages()
Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1)
install.packages("Deducer",type="source")

Ian

messages.subject: Re: eps rotated
messages.subject_clean: eps rotated
messages.body_plain:
The default is to print in the landscape orientation. You can use the
following to get non-landscape plots:

postscript("plot.eps",horizontal=FALSE)
plot(1:10)
dev.off()

Ian
